title: Nobody wants to read your sh*t
subtitle: Or anything for that matter
html:
I’ve been reading Steven Pressfield’s “Nobody Wants to Read Your Shit.”

The premise is this:

Since nobody wants to read your shit, you gotta make whatever you write so interesting, so sexy, so compelling that a person would have to be crazy NOT to read it.

This is true for every art, not just writing.

Food for thought.
